Task: Managed NoSQL Document Store

Write Python code that upserts a JSON document by its primary identifier using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
from pymongo import MongoClient

# Connect to MongoDB Atlas (or any MongoDB Atlas-compatible service)
client = MongoClient("mongodb+srv://<username>:<password>@cluster0.mongodb.net/test?retryWrites=true&w=majority")

# Select the database and collection
db = client["mydatabase"]
collection = db["mycollection"]

# Document to upsert
document = {
    "id": "12345",
    "name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john.doe@example.com"
}

# Upsert the document
result = collection.update_one(
    {"id": document["id"]},
    {"$set": document},
    upsert=True
)

print(f"Upserted {result.modified_count + result.upserted_count} document(s)")
```
